rationale: All three codex hard stops from the prior run are resolved in the current plan at sha256:41a1e8b6dddc12da502db305e7044570f121784903e4183cf17a03a2ca100ef7. (1) Entrypoint: `pylae-verify-bootstrap` is now unambiguously the sole supported user-facing entrypoint throughout; the raw launcher and `node pylae` are explicitly unsupported in both the boot-sequence paragraph and the per-invocation regressions. (2) Boot-order: the BOOT-ORDER regression now correctly names all three pre-root artifacts — STATIC bootstrap, STATIC launcher, and STATIC sandbox-builder — with the guarantee stated as no dynamic Node/interpreter/library byte before the authenticated root, not 'only the sandbox-builder.' (3) Pre-filter bound: the PRECISE BOUND clause now explicitly grounds the prologue's guarantee in the hand-audited statically-compiled listener-free prologue — NOT in the filter retroactively covering code before it is installed — with the BOOTSTRAP-FILTER-FIRST regression correctly scoped to listener attempts AFTER the prologue. No new contradictions introduced by the run-10/run-11 folds: the filter-inheritance chain is internally consistent (bootstrap prologue installs filter; launcher inherits it un-droppably, may idempotently re-assert, owns env-scrub and sandbox-builder verification; builder establishes inode-frozen verity root; Node runs inside the root), the sealed-memfd TOCTOU closure is applied consistently at every handoff, and the plan makes no overclaim about the launcher's role after the bootstrap takes filter ownership. E1–E6 enforcement mechanisms, two-phase DISCOVERY-001 governance, atomic-weave rule, accepted spikes with fail-closed interim postures and honest non-claims, and repository trust model invariants all remain sound. SPIKE-E6-EVALUATOR-FORM is ratified: enrollment of new/changed normative oracles is blocked at oracle-evaluator-pending until the declarative evaluator passes its hard merge gate; the interim controls are correctly characterized as non-authoritative compensating controls, not soundness proof. SPIKE-PD001-NOLISTENER-COMPLETENESS is ratified: the kernel-inherited seccomp architecture is conceptually sound and fail-closed; only exhaustive Linux syscall/loader/namespace corner enumeration is deferred, with CI eBPF+strace detection as explicitly-labeled interim detection, not enforcement. The plan is implementation-ready against its own stated terms.
